bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 40cm x 40cm x 20cm are not allowed into Manchester Academy. All bags are searched at entry.
prohibited: Bags and containers larger than 40cm x 40cm x 20cm
bagPolicy.note: At Academy 2, Academy 3 and Club Academy, bags larger than A4 must be checked into the cloakroom (£2). Cloakrooms are available at all the venues. Refusing a search means no entry.

parking.note: No specific parking options or pricing information is provided on the venue's website. Visitors are advised to consider public transport or nearby parking facilities.

rideshare.note: To book a private-hire taxi, call Street Cars on 0161 228 7878 or use its app. The venue lists Street Cars as its approved taxi service.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Manchester Academy varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Manchester Academy, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Manchester Academy. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Manchester Academy. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
